readings: For each media type (by name), compute its rate as total Bytes divided by total Milliseconds over all its tracks (ratio of sums, not rounded). Take the simple, unweighted average of these per-media-type rates across all media types that have tracks. Return the media types whose rate is higher than that average, with the media type name, its rate, and the rate minus the average, all unrounded.

For each media type (by name), compute its rate as the average over its tracks of each track's Bytes divided by Milliseconds (mean of per-track ratios, not rounded). Take the simple, unweighted average of these per-media-type rates across all media types that have tracks. Return the media types whose rate is higher than that average, with the media type name, its rate, and the rate minus the average, all unrounded.
queries:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS diff
FROM rates r, avg_rate a
WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate;
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM MediaType m
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - o.avg_rate AS diff
FROM rates r, overall o
WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate;
